description: This file defines a PHP trait named NestedSetTrait within the OrangeHRM ORM module. The trait provides a method fetchTree() that retrieves a hierarchical tree structure from the database, implementing a nested set model for representing hierarchical data.

methods.name: fetchTree
methods.description: Retrieves a nested set tree structure from the database with an optional depth limit, throwing an exception if the calling class does not implement NestedSetInterface.
